title: Chemical Drain Cleaners vs Mechanical Clearing
description: Relying on caustic liquid drain cleaners to clear severe drain line blockages creates safety and structural hazards. Caustic chemicals often sit trapped behind dense clogs, generating localized heat that can deform Schedule 40 PVC piping, damage pipe seals, or corrode older metallic lines. Furthermore, chemicals rarely remove complete blockages like root intrusion or heavy grease buildup. Professional plumbers rely on mechanical clearing methods, such as drain cables or hydro-jetting equipment, to physically scour pipe walls clean without risking chemical burns, pipe degradation, or environmental contamination.
